item.title: [DEMO] Example Automation Co. FlowLogix PLC firmware: authentication bypass in web interface
item.description: FICTIONAL SAMPLE. Example Automation Co. reports that the web interface of FlowLogix PLC firmware could allow an unauthenticated attacker on the control network to change configuration. The vendor recommends restricting access to the engineering network. This is demo data for the OT & PLC Security Brief.
